item.title: TNVC: Built on Trust. Driven by Education. Forged in the Dark.
item.description: TNVC did not begin as a company chasing trends. It began as a response to a real operational problem. item.title: Sneak Peek – Hill People Gear Traveler
item.description: The upcoming Traveler from Hill People Gear was developed to solve the relatively common problem of how to carry one bag into a hotel room that contains your clothing and a compact weapon in its own compartment.
